evidence.note: Crystal structure of PCSK9:LDLR EGF-A complex defines the D374-F379 allosteric hinge.

experiments.design: AlphaFold 3 co-folding + fpocket + AutoDock Vina docking
experiments.readout: ipTM, pocket druggability score, and kcal/mol pose

experiments.design: HepG2 cell-surface LDLR restoration and rat/dog oral PK

focus_area: Allosteric Oral Small-Molecule Inhibition of PCSK9
mechanism: Allosteric wedge insertion at the catalytic-CTD hinge displaces the EGF-A beta-hairpin contact loop (D374-Y379) without requiring a >800 Da macrocycle.
predictions: AutoDock Vina binding energy <= -7.5 kcal/mol for pcsk9_ic001
Oral bioavailability F >= 30% in rat and dog PK
statement: A dynamic cryptic sub-pocket (Pocket #3, 299 A^3, druggability 0.788) adjacent to the D374/F379/S381 EGF-A interface stabilizes a conformation incompatible with LDLR binding, enabling MW < 420 Da oral small molecules.
title: Cryptic Allosteric Groove Between PCSK9 Catalytic and C-Terminal Domains Permits Oral Rule-of-5 Disruption
